changes: Single-entry pure selection cache keyed by private library/context identity and override; cached only for absent or resolver-branded immutable catalogue.
Reuse owned library directly when stored selection equals session override.
Raw catalogue inputs are revalidated on every selection; dynamic published permissions, failed IDs and authored adapters are evaluated outside the cache.
No snapshot, playback position, shuffled queue, transport state or asynchronous operation is cached.
behavioralRegressions: Library, context/theme and explicit override changes; invalid setters retain previous valid state.
Installed IDs and listening/Recording mode invalidate selection; consecutive snapshots observe changed media position.
Raw authority can revoke and restore a same-hash uploaded alias without changing the library.
Published permissions, authored replacements and failed published adapters remain dynamic.
